```python
#Getting the G and C count and content of the sequence
```


```python
with open("C:/Users/VivaA/2214/IntroBiolComp-2026/Python/DataFiles/Turkey_transcripts_15.fasta", "r") as f:
    lines = f.readlines()
for i in range(0, len(lines), 2):
    name =  lines[i].strip()
    sequence = lines[i + 1].strip()

    GCcount = sequence.count("G") + sequence.count ("C")
    GCcontent = (GCcount / len(sequence)) * 100
```
